A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BioCLIP 2 and TREEOFLIFE-200M. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–J are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original species-classification, biological-task, scaling, and ablation results in Tables 1–3 and 6–7 and the accompanying figures.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and reports replacement DINOv3 comparisons and additional analysis of training-label granularity.

M1.justification: The proposed ViT-L/14 model, hierarchical contrastive training, LAION replay with a separate visual projector, and embedding extraction procedure are unchanged. Replacing an evaluated baseline does not alter BioCLIP 2.

E1.justification: Training datasets and evaluated tasks are unchanged. IDLE-OO Camera Traps was already described in v1 Appendix F.4; its increased prominence in v2 is not new coverage. Table 9 characterizes the existing training dataset.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 2, and 7 replace DINOv2 with DINOv3 for few-shot species classification and non-species tasks. The other evaluated comparators remain unchanged, making this a limited comparator substitution.

E3.justification: Appendix E changes the evaluated DINO configuration from ViT-large with patch size 14 to ViT-large with patch size 16. The stated input-resolution default, downstream evaluation procedures, splits, shot counts, and BioCLIP 2 training budget remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 9 adds a descriptive analysis of how much training data carries annotations at each taxonomic rank, addressing label specificity. The scaling, replay, loss, and embedding analyses are retained. The illustrative fossil/amber curation case in v1 Appendix I.2.1 and Figure 14 is removed.

E5.justification: The existing plus/minus reporting practice is retained. Neither version introduces different seed counts, repeated-run information, confidence intervals, or significance procedures. Different uncertainty values in the replacement DINO rows are result changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1, 2, and 7 replace DINOv2 results with DINOv3 results. For example, Table 2 reports means of 47.3 for DINOv2 in v1 and 48.6 for DINOv3 in v2, while BioCLIP 2 remains at 57.5. Table 9 adds rank-wise statistics, including 197,382,628 species-labeled images (92.26%). These are new comparator results and dataset statistics, not gains for an unchanged model.

T1.justification: Theorem 5.1, its assumptions and Appendix C proof, and the explained-variance and Fisher Discriminant Ratio definitions are mathematically unchanged. Proof edits concern punctuation and wording.

C1.justification: The introduction updates its quantified baseline-superiority claim from a 10.9% average margin to 10.3% and names DINOv3 instead of DINOv2. The central dataset, model, scaling, and emergent-property claims in the abstract and conclusion remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix I.1 adds the qualification that ambiguous labels were mapped to higher taxonomic ranks and interprets the new statistics as showing predominantly species-level supervision. Existing explanations of emergence, neural collapse, and theoretical and dataset limitations are retained.

D1.justification: Appendix E updates the baseline configuration and links to the corresponding DINOv3 checkpoint. Appendix I.1 newly documents upward mapping of ambiguous labels. BioCLIP 2 hyperparameters, hardware, training time, and project resource-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 replaces the DINOv2 reference with DINOv3, adds AVA-Bench and a formal distributed-downloader citation, and removes the source citation associated with the fossil illustration. The broader research positioning and novelty argument remain stable.

P1.justification: Changes comprise localized grammatical corrections, a short explanation accompanying Table 9, removal of the fossil-example passage, and more explicit camera-trap naming. The section sequence is retained, and the first-page footer changes from Preprint to NeurIPS 2025.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 9 and removes v1 Figure 14 showing fossil/amber images; the former Figure 15 becomes Figure 14. Several appendix figures and tables are repositioned, and Table 7's caption expands. The main visual organization and retained figures are largely unchanged.

improvement.justification: v1 acknowledged incomplete species labels without quantifying their overall prevalence; v2's Table 9 makes this important training-data property explicit. The DINOv3 comparisons also update the empirical evidence while retaining BioCLIP 2's results. Removing DINOv2 and one curation illustration reduces some comparative and explanatory breadth, but the added transparency provides a modest net benefit. The core method and theoretical support are unchanged.
